title: WordTrail words.json (editor output, agent input)
description: One file = one lesson. Only what the user knows: the word, its sentence and the date. File name: lessons/<id>.json.

id.description: Lesson id: date + short slug. Also the file name of the lesson everywhere.

date.description: Day the lesson is grouped under (YYYY-MM-DD).

url.description: Optional link to the source text.

text.description: Word or phrase exactly as in the text. Key of content.json items.

kind.description: For phrases the agent looks for the normal form (turned it down -> turn down).

sentence.description: Context sentence as selected in the editor (may contain glued headings, typos).

note.description: Optional hint for the agent: which meaning the user means.
